user_intent: setup a working stock xubuntu xfce instance replacing our current one; get network/wifi operational; xubuntu means linuxserver/webtop ubuntu-xfce, not plain ubuntu
method: live witnessed execution in qqbox guests plus two independent recon agents (registry identity, network data plane) and an adversarial verification pass

claims.claim: The digest in the URL is a layer blob or the config blob
evidence: GET /v2/linuxserver/webtop/manifests/ubuntu-xfce-824a4465-ls171 -> manifest.list.v2, index sha256:43141025abe50bde82b1a1757a524425ce36476ad50c187656e921b62b906f12
index arm64 child = sha256:5f170506429db91eba6aae8c6366185d71bc842980d1b0d9caa179e91c965c55
GET /v2/.../manifests/sha256:5f170506... -> manifest.v2, 3058 bytes, config sha256:68f14933...fcfe, 14 layers
arm64v8-ubuntu-xfce-824a4465-ls171 tag resolves directly to that digest
hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/linuxserver/webtop/tags?name=ubuntu-xfce-824a4465-ls171 -> count 3, matching digests
claims.root_cause: Docker Hub's /layers/.../images/sha256-<digest> page names the platform image manifest, not a filesystem layer. The earlier empty 'podman manifest inspect' output was a broken SSH known_hosts entry (exit 125), not a missing tag.

claims.claim: The stock image runs unmodified under qqbox
evidence: first pull failed: 'unpack ... usr/bin/thunar: openat usr/bin/thunar: too many levels of symbolic links'
reproduced on the host: case-insensitive APFS + os.Root.Symlink('thunar','Thunar') + r.OpenFile('thunar', O_CREATE|O_TRUNC) -> 'openat thunar: too many levels of symbolic links'
image has usr/bin/Thunar -> thunar AND regular usr/bin/thunar (63,187 flattened tar entries, zero duplicate paths)
internal/oci/unpack_unix.go now calls replaceLink before writing a directory, regular file or hard link; second pull succeeded
cargo build --workspace passes (gate, not the proof of this fix)

live A/B: first pull failed with that exact ELOOP; the rebuilt CLI unpacked all 63,187 flattened entries; an adversarial verifier neutralized replaceLink via Go -overlay and reproduced the original error while the committed suite still passed
probe.log: PRETTY_NAME='Ubuntu 24.04 LTS' (VERSION='24.04 LTS (Noble Numbat)'), /usr/share/xubuntu, XFCE binaries, WEBTOP_PROBE_DONE
claims.adapter_1: ENTRYPOINT /init is s6-overlay; qqbox runs one program, so the derived image clears ENTRYPOINT and uses its own start script. The XFCE session itself is the stock /usr/bin/xfce4-session.
claims.adapter_2: Stock KasmVNC Xvnc serves HTTP/websocket on 3000. Its traditional -rfbport mode completes the RFB handshake (ServerInit 1280x800 bpp=32 depth=24 name='x11') but sends zero framebuffer updates: 'ComparingUpdateTracker: 0 pixels in / 0 pixels out', 'EncodeManager: 0 rects, 0 pixels', across raw/full-encoding-list/-CompareFB 0/pointer-first variants. Five apt packages (x11vnc, Xvfb, scrot, xdotool, netsurf-gtk) are added. The derived guest's RFB capture then returned raw_bytes=4096000 with distinct_colors=6714 (final-5905-desktop.png) and 8837 after the terminal was used (final-restored.png).

claims.claim: The XFCE terminal is a real native terminal
evidence: internal/sandbox/lx_termios.go: lxTIOCPKT = 0x5420
internal/sandbox/pty_unix.go: case lxTIOCPKT forwards to the host pty master via unix.IoctlSetPointerInt (pointer form, not value form)
probe/tiocpkt-direct.txt: TIOCPKT_OK /dev/pts/13, TIOCPKT_OFF_OK
probe/native3-typed.png: VNC KeyEvent typed 'echo VNC_NATIVE_TERMINAL_OK; id; uname -a' -> echoed input, output and / # prompt
stock desktop windows.txt: 0x... QQBOX-XUBUNTU-TERMINAL ("xfce4-terminal" "Xfce4-terminal") 858x521
stock xubuntu-xwd.png: root@qqbox:/# prompt in the stock xfce4-terminal
claims.root_cause: Linux TIOCPKT was unhandled (ENOTTY); a success-only stub removed the error but left VTE reading an unframed stream (black window); value-form forwarding gave EFAULT ('Bad address'); pointer-form forwarding fixes both. terminalrc is ignored; colors must be written to Xfconf.

claims.claim: Guest network/wifi is broken and needs a new stack
evidence: with -net: raw UDP DNS to 127.0.0.1:53, 8.8.8.8:53, 1.1.1.1:53 all return rcode=0 with 2 answers
with -net: getent hosts example.com -> 2606:4700:10::..., TCP 1.1.1.1:443 OK
with -net: curl https://example.com/ -> HTTP 200 104.20.23.154; https://www.google.com/ -> HTTP 200
with -net: apt-get update inside the stock Xubuntu guest fetched 65.2 MB
without -net: Chromium in the separate examples/xfce Alpine guest shows 'No internet / Reconnecting to Wi-Fi / ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED'
with -net: NetSurf in the stock Xubuntu guest rendered the real Example Domain page (netsurf-http.png)
-allow-domains example.com REFUSED other DNS queries and blocked direct-IP connects; the flags only restrict
internal/sandbox/egress.go:99-127 default allows all non-loopback; net_unix.go:872-879 intercepts :53; msg_unix.go:658-713 answers in-supervisor
claims.root_cause: A guest launched without -net has virtual INET sockets with no host reach and no DNS proxy, so a browser renders its generic offline boilerplate. 'Reconnecting to Wi-Fi' is Chromium's suggestion text, witnessed in the separate Alpine example; it is not a wifi driver failure. The Go runtime does not generate /etc/resolv.conf; start-xubuntu.sh writes 'nameserver 8.8.8.8' for deterministic glibc clients.
claims.honest_boundary: 802.11 wifi cannot be emulated: qqbox pairs socket endpoints, not packets (internal/sandbox/VNET.md:19-26). No AF_PACKET/TUN, raw sockets, ICMP, nl80211 or wireless extensions; netlink RTM_GETLINK mirrors host interfaces. NetworkManager/wpa_supplicant/iw are absent from the image. ping failing is expected. Working DNS+TCP+HTTPS egress and a browser that loads real pages is the honest equivalent.

claims.claim: The stock Firefox renders web pages under qqbox
evidence: final-5906/firefox.log: 'Sandbox: chroot: EPERM' and '[Parent 129, IPC I/O Parent] WARNING: process 251 exited on signal 11'

MOZ_DISABLE_CONTENT_SANDBOX=1, all sandbox-disable env variants, MOZ_FORCE_DISABLE_E10S=1, security.sandbox.content.level=0, network.trr.mode=5 and layers.acceleration.disabled=true were each tried; all produced a blank or perpetually loading page
https://example.com/ appears in Firefox's address bar but its content area stays blank
claims.root_cause: Firefox's content sandbox calls chroot(), which qqbox's vfs-Namespace-only filesystem refuses; the renderer dies. This is a browser compatibility limit, NOT a network failure: curl, apt and NetSurf all reach the same URLs in the same guest. Chromium is not installed in this image; its offline boilerplate was witnessed in the separate Alpine example.

claims.claim: A browser in the stock Xubuntu guest renders a real public HTTPS page
evidence: netsurf-gtk installed from Ubuntu noble universe; netsurf-http.png shows 'Example Domain - NetSurf' with the real https://example.com/ body and 'Done (0.0s)'
a local file:// page rendered LOCAL_RENDER_OK, isolating renderer from network
final-5905/xubuntu-browser.png on the live 5905 desktop shows the Xubuntu wallpaper, the NetSurf Example Domain page and the native terminal
windowed Chromium on Xvfb in the Alpine example rendered 'Example Domain - Chromium'
claims.note: NetSurf is added to the derived Dockerfile as the default browser. Firefox remains installed but is not launched.

evidence: config TITLE=Ubuntu XFCE; /etc/os-release ID=ubuntu, PRETTY_NAME='Ubuntu 24.04 LTS'
image history[37]: apt-get install firefox mousepad xfce4-terminal xfce4 xubuntu-default-settings xubuntu-icon-theme
/usr/share/xubuntu and /etc/xdg/xdg-xubuntu present

claims.note: This is the exact image the user linked. It is Ubuntu 24.04 + XFCE + Xubuntu's default settings and icon theme, not the Xubuntu distro. Surfaced rather than silently substituted.

live_cutover.image: qqbox-xubuntu:stock (DERIVED, not the pristine stock rootfs)
live_cutover.derivation: 5 added apt packages, ENTRYPOINT cleared, CMD replaced by /usr/local/bin/start-xubuntu.sh, s6-overlay /init and KasmVNC bypassed, custom /etc/resolv.conf and chown /config. The XFCE session, xfce4-terminal, Firefox, Thunar and Xubuntu theme are the image's own.
live_cutover.vnc_readiness: x11vnc starts 5s after launch (stages.log 22:35:49 -> 22:35:54) and is alive at 22:35:57, before the XFCE session

known_warnings: Firefox's content sandbox tries chroot() -> EPERM and crashes renderers under qqbox; it stays installed but is not launched. Verified against five sandbox-disable variants.
xdg-user-dir missing from the Xubuntu template script; AT-SPI/UPower/PolicyKit services absent
apt's libc-bin/mandb trigger cannot write /var/cache/man in qqbox's unprivileged unpack; the Dockerfile tolerates that trigger and asserts the binaries exist
x11vnc -nopw is wildcard-bound and LAN-reachable; -localhost breaks qqbox port forwarding; use -rfbauth to close it
